fusions.name: Many-Armed Lunge
fusions.desc: Thrusts four tines out in a fan, each dealing 3 damage to the first enemy it meets within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Inked Cast
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Hurls a dark tine that deals 8 damage, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Jet Away
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds and raises your dodge chance by 10% while it lasts. It also blinks you 3 tiles on use.

fusions.name: Every Arm Busy
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.
